title: One-time recovery custody authorization for native device signers
changes: After verified 24-word Farcaster recovery, optionally authorize a per-device Ed25519 signer through a one-shot EIP-712 KEY_ADD and SignedKeyRequest.
Require explicit, localized device signer consent on the native setup screen.
Tie the temporary custody authorization to the exact verified FID and custody address, expire it within three minutes, and zeroize key material after one attempted authorization.
Continue to select the actual write/signing provider using user-pinned routing capabilities; HyperSnap is the default reader, never a silent signer fallback.
Verify cryptographic compatibility against independent Noble vectors and execute native C++ regression tests.
security: Never persist custody phrase or private key; network confirmation and secure device signer vault remain mandatory.
